summary.text: Greg Hill is the Democratic candidate for Michigan State Senate District 23 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 4 Democratic primary.
A small business owner, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his campaign focuses on making life more affordable for working families.

paragraphs.text: Hill graduated from Lakeland High School and attended Central Michigan University, where he earned a bachelor's degree.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in White Lake, studied education at Central Michigan University, and then returned home to raise a family and build a small business with his wife, with a business in Lake Orion.
He said his family now lives in Oxford and that he has coached youth sports in Lake Orion, Oxford and Brandon.
Hill described his campaign as focused on the rising cost of groceries, housing, utilities and energy for working families.

sources.title: Greg Hill - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2026)
